title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.

Construction Project Manager

Location: Culver City, CA
Department: Real Estate / Construction
Employment Type: Full-Time / Onsite 5x a Week
Travel: Approximately 35–40%
Salary: $120,000–$145,000

Opportunity Overview

POP MART is seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to support the continued expansion of our retail footprint across the United States.

This role will manage multiple retail construction projects from pre-construction through store opening and handover, with responsibility for budgets, schedules, permitting, contractor management, construction execution, and project closeout. You will partner closely with internal Real Estate, Design, Store Operations, architects, general contractors, landlords, and vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to POP MART's quality and brand standards.

The ideal candidate brings strong retail or commercial construction experience, can manage multiple projects simultaneously, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly growing environment.

We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture.

What You Will Achieve

• Manage multiple retail construction projects from pre-construction and bidding through construction, punch list, turnover, and store opening.

• Develop, monitor, and manage project budgets, schedules, and key milestones while maintaining quality, safety, and brand standards.

• Coordinate with internal teams, architects, engineers, landlords, general contractors, vendors, and other project partners throughout the project lifecycle.

• Review General Contractor bids, support contractor selection, and manage contractor performance against approved scope, budget, and schedule.

• Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, proposal requests, supplemental instructions, and other construction documentation.

• Partner with the Architect of Record (AOR) to ensure construction documents incorporate required design elements, internal and vendor markups, shop drawings, and technical requirements prior to bidding and construction.

• Proactively identify project risks, schedule delays, cost impacts, and scope changes, developing mitigation and contingency plans as needed.

• Lead recurring construction progress meetings and maintain clear documentation of project schedules, action items, change order logs, material approvals, and key decisions.

• Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, quality, safety, and adherence to approved plans and specifications.

• Coordinate punch lists, inspections, project closeout, and handover to Store Operations to support successful and timely store openings.

• Partner cross-functionally with Real Estate, Design, Store Operations, Procurement, Finance, and other stakeholders to support POP MART's U.S. retail expansion.

• Identify opportunities to improve construction processes, project controls, vendor performance, and overall speed to market.

What You Will Need

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 5–7 years of commercial construction project management experience, with retail construction strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple construction projects simultaneously from pre-construction through completion.

• Strong knowledge of construction budgeting, scheduling, bidding, change orders, RFIs, submittals, permitting, and project closeout.

• Experience working directly with architects, engineers, general contractors, landlords, vendors, and cross-functional business partners.

• Strong financial and analytical skills with experience managing project budgets and identifying cost risks.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and aggressive project timelines.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with construction/project management tools.

• Ability to travel approximately 35–40% throughout the United States by land and air.

• Competitive benefits: 401(k), health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.

• Growth opportunities: On-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments.

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Merchandiser, E-commerce Business Planning Intern

Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Type: Part-time, Fixed Term

Department: Merchandising, E-commerce Business Planning

Industry: Designer Toys & Collectibles

Reporting to: Head of Merchandising

About POP MART

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions and, through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is continuing to expand across the region.

For more information, please visit www.popmart.com and our LinkedIn Career page.

What to Expect

POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:

Gain hands-on experience in e-commerce and merchandising.

Learn how products are planned, launched and managed online.

Work with colleagues across different European markets and functions.

Develop your Excel, data and commercial skills.

Work with exciting POP MART products and IPs.

Be part of a growing international team and contribute to real business projects.

Benefits

POP MART offers our employees:

Monthly POP MART appreciation gifts.

25 days of annual leave, in addition to bank holidays.

Employee Assistance Programme and discount platform.

Training, development programmes and regular team events.

The Opportunity

Support the team with e-commerce product planning and inventory management.

Help track product sales, stock levels and product availability.

Support new product launches across online channels.

Help prepare simple reports and analyse sales data.

Work with Merchandising, E-commerce, Supply Chain and other teams.

Gain a practical understanding of how an international e-commerce business operates.

The Role and Candidate

This is an entry-level role designed for someone who wants to learn about e-commerce, merchandising and business planning.

You will work closely with the Merchandising team and support day-to-day activities such as checking sales and stock data, preparing reports, supporting product launches and helping the team keep product information accurate.

You don't need to be an expert. We are looking for someone who is curious, organised, comfortable with numbers and keen to learn.

The ideal candidate will enjoy working with products, data and people, and will be comfortable using Excel and Microsoft Office. You should be proactive, detail-oriented and happy to ask questions and learn along the way.

E-commerce & Merchandising

Help track product sales and stock levels.

Support product launches and maintain the e-commerce product calendar.

Help monitor product availability across online channels.

Assist with product and assortment planning.

Support the team with simple sales and inventory analysis.

Prepare regular sales and inventory reports.

Help keep product and inventory data accurate.

Use Excel to organise and analyse information.

Highlight any unusual changes or potential stock issues to the team.

Team Support

Work with Merchandising, E-commerce, Supply Chain and other teams.

Help follow up on day-to-day tasks and projects.

Support the team with ad hoc projects when needed.

Learn how different teams work together to launch and sell POP MART products.

Studying towards, or recently graduated from, a degree in Business, Economics, Retail, Marketing, Supply Chain, Data Analytics or a related subject.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

Comfortable working with numbers and data.

Good attention to detail and organisational skills.

Good English communication skills.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Able to work well both independently and as part of a team.

Desirable but Not Essential

Previous internship or part-time experience in e-commerce, retail or merchandising.

Experience with Excel, data analysis or reporting.

Experience with e-commerce platforms or ERP systems.

Interest in toys, collectibles, fashion, entertainment or consumer products.

Additional European language skills.

Apply

If you are curious about e-commerce and want to learn how a global consumer brand plans, launches and sells its products, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a great opportunity to gain practical experience, develop your commercial and analytical skills, and grow with POP MART's expanding European team.

Procurement Coordinator

Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Visual Merchandising, Europe

Industry: Designer Toys & Collectibles

Reporting to: Head of Visual Merchandising Europe

About POP MART

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions and, through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms, reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world's first immersive intellectual property themed park in the art toy industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of art toy expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally.

In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high-potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.

For more information, please visit www.popmart.com and our LinkedIn Career page.

What to Expect

POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:

Support a fast-growing European business that combines retail, e-commerce, IP, marketing and creative storytelling.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams across multiple European markets.

Gain hands-on experience supporting the procurement and delivery of creative materials that bring POP MART campaigns, stores and customer experiences to life.

Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders across different countries and functions within an international business.

Contribute to campaigns, store openings, seasonal activations and other key commercial initiatives.

Develop your procurement, coordination and commercial operations skills in a dynamic and rapidly expanding environment.

Benefits

POP MART offers our employees:

Monthly appreciation gifts featuring our latest POP MART designs.

A structured bonus scheme linked to both company and individual performance.

25 days of annual leave, in addition to bank holidays.

4x life insurance, together with group medical and travel insurance.

A confidential Employee Assistance Programme, alongside access to a discount platform for selected online retailers.

Training and development programmes, together with regular team events that encourage learning, collaboration and celebration.

The Opportunity

Support the procurement and delivery of visual merchandising materials, POS materials, campaign materials, VM props and gifts with purchase (GWP) across POP MART Europe.

Play a key coordination role in ensuring purchasing requirements are processed accurately and delivered in line with campaign launches, store openings and commercial priorities.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams to understand purchasing requirements and coordinate orders across different European markets.

Manage purchase orders from initial request through to delivery, maintaining accurate records and proactively following up on outstanding actions.

Build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders to help ensure materials are delivered on time and to the required specifications.

Join a growing European team and contribute to improving procurement processes and ways of working as POP MART continues to expand.

The Role and Candidate

This is a hands-on coordination role within the Visual Merchandising, Europe team, supporting the procurement and delivery of materials required for POP MART's retail, marketing and visual merchandising activities.

Working closely with the Head of Visual Merchandising Europe and teams across Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising, you will be responsible for coordinating purchase orders for VM props, POS materials, campaign materials, gifts with purchase and other related items across European markets.

The role requires strong organisation and attention to detail, as you will manage multiple purchase orders, suppliers, delivery requirements and deadlines simultaneously. You will be responsible for ensuring orders are raised accurately, tracked effectively and delivered in line with campaign launches, store openings and other commercial priorities.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in purchasing, procurement, buying administration, merchandising operations or a similar coordination role, ideally within retail, consumer products, FMCG or another fast-paced commercial environment.

You will thrive in this role if you are highly organised, proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You should enjoy working collaboratively with different teams, be confident following up on outstanding actions and be able to identify and escalate potential issues before they affect delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their procurement and commercial operations experience within a growing international retail business.

Responsibilities

Purchase Order & Procurement Coordination

Manage purchase orders for VM props, POS materials, campaign materials, gifts with purchase and other related items across POP MART Europe.

Coordinate purchasing requirements with Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Retail, E-commerce and Merchandising teams.

Ensure orders are raised accurately with the correct quantities, specifications, delivery locations and required dates.

Review purchasing requests to ensure all required information is complete before orders are placed.

Maintain clear visibility of purchase order status, outstanding actions and expected delivery dates.

Support the procurement process from initial request through to final delivery.

Supplier & Stakeholder Coordination

Liaise with suppliers to confirm orders, specifications, quantities, delivery requirements and timelines.

Follow up proactively with suppliers on outstanding orders, delivery updates and potential delays.

Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand changing requirements and communicate updates effectively.

Support coordination across different European markets and business functions.

Build positive and effective working relationships with suppliers and internal teams.

Campaign, Store Opening & Commercial Support

Coordinate purchasing requirements in line with campaign launches, store openings and other key commercial activities.

Ensure materials are ordered and delivered within agreed timelines.

Work closely with Visual Merchandising and Marketing teams to support seasonal campaigns, activations and promotional activities.

Coordinate gifts with purchase (GWP) requirements across different European markets.

Support the delivery of materials required for new store openings and other retail initiatives.

Proactively identify potential delivery risks and escalate issues where required.

Order Tracking & Documentation

Track orders from placement through to delivery and proactively follow up on delays, changes or outstanding actions.

Maintain accurate purchasing trackers, order records and supporting documentation.

Ensure key purchasing information is kept up to date and readily accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Monitor order quantities, delivery dates and specifications to help prevent discrepancies.

Provide regular updates on purchasing status and outstanding orders where required

Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

Support the resolution of delivery, quantity, invoice and other purchasing discrepancies.

Liaise with suppliers and relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues promptly.

Escalate material purchasing or delivery issues when appropriate.

Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, tracking and ways of working.

Support the development of more efficient procurement processes as POP MART's European business continues to grow.

Required Qualifications

2–3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, merchandising operations, buying administration or a similar coordination role.

Experience raising and managing purchase orders, preferably within retail, consumer products, FMCG or another fast-paced commercial environment.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple orders, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail when handling order information, quantities, specifications and documentation.

Strong communication and coordination skills, with confidence working across different teams and European markets.

Proactive approach to following up actions, identifying potential delays and escalating issues when required.

Good Excel and general systems capability.

Strong administrative and record-keeping skills.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change according to campaign, launch and business needs.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable but Not Essential

Experience working within visual merchandising, retail, marketing, buying, merchandising or store operations.

Experience procuring POS materials, promotional materials, retail fixtures, props, gifts with purchase or similar creative/commercial items.

Experience supporting retail campaigns, seasonal activations or new store openings.

Experience working with purchasing, ERP, finance or procurement systems.

Experience working with suppliers across multiple countries or international markets.

Experience coordinating purchasing activities across different European markets.

Stronger-than-basic Excel skills, including experience with spreadsheets, trackers and data management.

Experience working in a fast-growing international company.

European language skills, such as French, Italian, German or Spanish, would be an advantage.

Experience or interest in the designer toy, retail, e-commerce, marketing or entertainment industries.

Apply

If you are an organised and proactive procurement professional who enjoys coordinating multiple stakeholders, managing purchase orders and supporting exciting retail and marketing activities, we'd love to hear from you.

If you have strong attention to detail, excellent coordination skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving international environment, this could be an exciting opportunity to join POP MART's growing European Visual Merchandising team.

Position: Retail Assistant Manager

Location: Potomac Mills Mall

Department: Retail

Hourly: $17.50- $22.50

Opportunity Overview:

At POP MART, we believe art has the power to inspire joy, spark imagination, and bring people together. This position reports directly to the Store Manager.

Leadership & Talent Development

• Partner with the Store Manager to recruit, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing team.

• Lead, motivate, and develop Brand Associates and Sales Leads through coaching, feedback, and recognition.

• Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and customer-first culture that reflects POP MART's values.

• Serve as Manager on Duty, making operational and customer service decisions while ensuring an exceptional store experience.

• Support onboarding, training, and performance development of new team members.

Customer Experience

• Deliver an exceptional customer experience by leading from the sales floor and setting the standard for customer engagement.

• Inspire excitement around POP MART's artists, characters, Blind Boxes, MEGA Collections, and exclusive collaborations.

• Resolve customer concerns professionally while building long-term loyalty.

• Ensure every customer interaction reflects POP MART's premium brand experience.

Sales & Business Performance

• Sales

• Conversion

• Units Per Transaction (UPT)

• Average Transaction Value (ATV)

• Payroll productivity

• Inventory accuracy

• Analyze business results and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.

• Execute action plans to improve store performance and customer engagement.

• Promote new product launches, limited-edition releases, and seasonal campaigns.

• Ensure company policies, procedures, and loss prevention standards are consistently followed.

• Maintain an organized, clean, and safe store environment.

• Support scheduling, daily task planning, and operational execution.

• Monitor inventory accuracy, shipment processing, replenishment, transfers, and stockroom organization.

• Adjust merchandising based on inventory levels, sales trends, and business priorities.

• Partner with store leadership to maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, and replenishment.

• Ensure back-of-house organization supports efficient store operations.

Brand & Community

• Serve as a knowledgeable brand ambassador by staying current on POP MART's products, artists, characters, and company initiatives.

• Support in-store events, product launches, pop-up activations, conventions, Robo Shop operations, and new store openings.

• Build excitement within the local collector community while promoting POP MART's unique brand experience.

• Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced retail environment.
